_comment: Thèmes suivis par le composant « Géopolitique & news ». gdelt : requête GDELT (phrases entre guillemets, OR entre parenthèses). rss : requête Google News. weight : poids relatif du thème dans le composant. Ajoute/retire librement.

themes.label: Trump / Maison-Blanche
themes.gdelt: ("Trump tariffs" OR "Trump executive order" OR "Trump sanctions" OR "Trump crypto")
themes.rss: Trump tariffs OR sanctions OR "executive order" OR crypto

themes.label: Russie / Ukraine / OTAN
themes.rss: Putin OR Kremlin OR Ukraine war OR NATO

themes.label: Chine / Taïwan
themes.rss: China Taiwan OR "Xi Jinping" OR China tariffs

themes.label: Moyen-Orient / pétrole
themes.gdelt: ("Iran" OR "Israel strike" OR "oil prices" OR "Strait of Hormuz")
themes.rss: Iran OR Israel strike OR oil prices Hormuz

themes.label: Fed / macro US
themes.gdelt: ("Federal Reserve" OR "Powell" OR "rate hike" OR "inflation data")
themes.rss: Federal Reserve Powell rate OR inflation CPI

themes.label: Crypto / régulation
themes.gdelt: ("crypto regulation" OR "SEC crypto" OR "Ripple" OR "XRP" OR "bitcoin ETF" OR "stablecoin")
themes.rss: crypto regulation OR SEC OR Ripple XRP OR bitcoin ETF OR stablecoin

themes.label: IA / tech
themes.rss: AI bubble OR Nvidia earnings OR OpenAI OR AI regulation

themes.label: Marchés / récession
themes.gdelt: ("stock market" OR "recession" OR "bank failure" OR "credit crisis")
themes.rss: stock market selloff OR recession OR bank failure OR credit
